reviewed_findings.claim: Odd libc_start_main argument8ef9 and command table14214 bind manually decoded Thumb main/load; main forwards argc-1 and argv+1 to its command pointer.
limitations: Manual regions are not selected Ghidra-C completions; runtime CLI invocation is unobserved.

limitations: Bootloader preload is a separate source; no absence of live preferences or observed startup failure is claimed.
